capabilities: Capture Fleeting notes with custom folders and templates
Move notes to permanent and archive folders when tagged #permanent or #archive
Search and run commands from a Universal Palette with saved filters and pinned items
Browse and create Daily, weekly, and yearly notes in a calendar
Track writing statistics, streaks, and task completion per note and vault-wide
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later; includes an optional Initialize Seam setup that previews proposed changes before applying; supports English and Brazilian Portuguese; GPLv3 licensed; development docs live in a separate README.dev.md.
problem: Obsidian leaves capturing, filing, and revisiting notes as separate manual steps, which breaks writing flow and scatters finished work among active notes.

relations.evidence: To share activity with Obsidian Sync, enable Sync all other types on each device.
Inspired by Zettelkasten, Apple Notes, and Bear
Inspired by Zettelkasten, Apple Notes, and Bear

summary: Capture-and-organize workflow plugin that files notes automatically via tags and searches notes, files, tags, and commands from a Universal Palette.
